title: Mutual aid agreement to help Kauaʻi after Hurricane Lowell
summary: A bill would let Maui County help the County of Kauaʻi respond to and recover from a hurricane. The agreement does not require Maui County to send staff or resources it does not have or needs. A council member said Maui wants to help Kauaʻi because of the help Kauaʻi gave after the fire.
